overall_assessment: Section extraction for UiA works well: headings map cleanly to the codebook sections, learning outcomes keep all Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups, and Vilkår for å gå opp til eksamen lands in coursework_requirements rather than assessment. Almost all pre-pass flags (boilerplate, empty) are false alarms caused by identical practice-course texts shared across years or by legitimately short sections; only minor whitespace noise and mixed-in requirement text remain.

findings.description: Whitespace-only lines (a lone space between blank lines) are left inside learning_outcomes and course_content, producing irregular spacing in otherwise correct text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source HTML has space-only paragraphs; .clean_sections() does not collapse lines that contain only whitespace.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R, blank out lines matching ^\s+$ and collapse 3+ consecutive newlines to two.

findings.evidence: Det er krav om 100 % tilstedeværelse i praksis for å få bestått praksis.
findings.description: In the practice (PRA) courses the Eksamen text includes a 100 % attendance requirement for passing, a pass/approve gate that the codebook assigns to coursework_requirements. These courses have no separate Vilkår heading, so no coursework_requirements row is emitted. In MA courses a 70 % attendance requirement likewise stays inside teaching_methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Section split is heading-based only; requirement sentences embedded in the body of Eksamen or Undervisnings- og læringsformer are not detected.
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally add a UiA sentence-level post-step moving sentences matching 'krav om .* (tilstedeværelse|deltagelse)' to coursework_requirements; otherwise document as a known limitation.
